newsitem.title: HUNGARY: ZALAKERAMIA CONTINUES ITS RALLY TO RECORD.
newsitem.headline: ZALAKERAMIA CONTINUES ITS RALLY TO RECORD.

text.p: Hungarian tile manufacturer Zalakeramia extended this week's gains and rose to record levels again on Wednesday, traders said.
The stock outpaced other shares on the rising market and surged to a new high of 9,700 forints, after opening at 8,700, up from Tuesday's close of 8,500.
"This is still the result of the acquisition news," one trader said. He added the stock has also benefited from a positive market sentiment.

The stock had modest volume of less than 1,000 shares by 1129 GMT, despite the fact that Zalakeramia announced this morning that its General Director Gyorgy Katona put in an order (with a brokerage) for the sale of 1,000 shares he owned.
Zalakeramia will hold an extraordinary general meeting on February 12 to discuss issues related to its planned new acquisitions. It said three companies were of serious interest.
